_: TECHNO_RELEASE blocks, for the three shapes the fleet actually has.
Every field has a default (see doc/RELEASING.md), so most repositories
declare two or three lines. This file is documentation: the examples
are keyed by repository and a real .technoproj carries one of them

dollup._: A binary project with no registry leg -- the plain case.
dollup.name: dollup {tag}

_: A Python project that also publishes to PyPI. The registry leg stays
in this repository and keeps its file name: PyPI's trusted publishing
matches the OIDC claim against a workflow filename here, so the
upload cannot move into technoproj's shared workflow and publish.yml
cannot be renamed without re-registering the publisher first.
Declaring it is what tells `doctor` the separate file is deliberate.
aloeschema.name: aloeschema {tag}

_: Six build platforms, a container image, a PyPI leg and dev builds.
None of the platform detail belongs here -- that is the caller's own
build jobs, which the standard does not touch. Only `dev_builds`
changes anything the shared half does.
aloelite.name: Aloelite {tag}
